access.title: Who can reach this service
access.description: Every role is a row, every HTTP verb a column. Green is full access, amber is filtered, muted is none. Derived live from the role graph.
access.hint: Agents and API keys inherit these grants through their role. Click any granted cell to see exactly what that role can reach across the platform.

dialog.title: {{verb}} on {{service}}
dialog.hint: This is everything the role reaches, not just this service. Grants marked inherited come from a wildcard rule; explicit grants target one service. Edit the role to change what agents and keys under it can touch.
